articles.title: US-Iran war negotiations in limbo? Israel warns Trump, several American officials of Tehran's plan to attack
articles.description: Israel's Mossad has reportedly warned the CIA that Iran intends to target US President Donald Trump and senior administration officials. The intelligence comes amid fresh concerns over Tehran's alleged chemical weapons ambitions and growing tensions over stalled peace negotiations.

articles.title: Israel warned US of possible attack on Donald Trump using drones carrying explosives: Report
articles.description: Israeli officials say Mossad has warned that Iran may target Trump and top US officials, a threat that has reportedly changed how Trump deals with Iran talks.
